topic: What impact do next-gen feeder link technologies have on satellite architecture for real-time adaptive precoding updates?
consensus_response: Next-gen feeder link technologies significantly impact satellite architecture, particularly in real-time adaptive precoding updates. High latency inherent in satellite links (~300ms) affects Quality of Experience (QoE) for real-time applications. To mitigate this, designers must carefully balance capacity and latency, allocating sufficient resources to accommodate increased latency while minimizing waste. QoS architectures that consider both capacity and latency are essential for optimizing resource utilization.
reference_context: The reference context highlights the importance of considering satellite channel impairments on the Physical Layer (PHY). Next-gen feeder link technologies must account for large delays and Doppler shifts inherent in satellite links, affecting PHY procedures such as subcarrier spacing adjustments and timing advance protocols.
